# De kaldte bunden - så faldt AI-aktierne igen

**Feed**: store-penge  
**Published**: 2026-11-19  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Danish podcast Store Penge (not Swedish) on the AI-stock sell-off after Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang was ousted over a scandal involving chips smuggled into China. The hosts think the market is 'near the bottom' but say December's rate decision, a possible US government shutdown and Iran risk mean buyers may want to wait about a month, perhaps for a Christmas rally. They are bullish on AI demand into 2027 and on Anthropic's IPO for the long term, but expect heavy volatility in the first days. No Swedish small or mid-cap companies were discussed.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟡 NVDA — Nvidia | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Cheap at forward P/E ~10 after strong report and raised guidance, but the CEO scandal has not fully played out.

#### Reasoning

Guest (Kongsted): existing holders should hold and ride out the storm; buying is tempting long term. Expects more bad news on the China chip smuggling and more sentiment drag, like Dieselgate. Host Rosenvold warns of 5-8% daily swings from leveraged speculation; a Jensen comeback is upside optionality. New CFO-led operator management could make it a stronger cash case.

#### Sell Triggers

- scandal widens to other Nvidia executives over China smuggling
- guidance cut
- US government shutdown or Fed disappointment in December

> *"har man allerede aktien, så er det måske ikke det værste bare at holde den og ride stormen ud"*

---

### 🟢 AMD — AMD | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Guest bought at the Nov 15 low, up 22% since. Bullish on AI demand into 2027.

#### Reasoning

Guest bought during the Nasdaq -6.1% day. He sees strong AI demand (CoreWeave, Google Cloud) and is bullish into 2027, but says sentiment is poor short term so this is not necessarily a buy right now.

#### Sell Triggers

- AI demand slowdown
- prolonged negative AI sentiment

> *"det var faktisk den midlertidige bund i de aktier, jeg har købt indtil nu som var AMD, Micron og TSMC"*

---

### 🟢 MU — Micron | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Guest bought at the Nov 15 AI sell-off low.

#### Reasoning

Part of the guest's AI-hardware buying at the bottom. The long-term thesis rests on AI demand; he is cautious about short-term sentiment.

#### Sell Triggers

- AI demand slowdown

> *"AMD, Micron og TSMC"*

---

### 🟢 TSM — TSMC | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Guest bought at the Nov 15 low; up 2% since.

#### Reasoning

Part of the guest's AI-hardware buying, based on long-term AI demand.

#### Sell Triggers

- AI demand slowdown

> *"TSMC er kun 2% oppe"*

---

### 🟡 JNJ — Johnson & Johnson | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Defensive holding that has rallied; guest says healthcare stocks are still good bets.

#### Reasoning

Guest holds JNJ and Merck as a buffer against AI exposure. These stocks are near all-time highs because investors use them as hedges, and he thinks that trend may not be over.

#### Sell Triggers

- rotation back into tech/AI drains defensive demand

> *"nogle af de her sundhedsaktier er super gode bud stadig"*

---

### 🟡 MRK — Merck | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Defensive healthcare holding; guest says healthcare stocks are still good bets.

#### Reasoning

Same defensive-buffer thesis as JNJ.

#### Sell Triggers

- rotation back into tech/AI

> *"nogle af de her sundhedsaktier er super gode bud stadig"*

---

### 🟡 XOM — Exxon | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Neutral | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Defensive energy holding the guest uses to diversify.

#### Reasoning

Guest holds energy stocks as a defensive counterweight to AI exposure. Host notes the oil price is falling.

#### Sell Triggers

- oil price keeps falling
- rotation back into tech

> *"nogle af energiaktierne, altså Exxon og sådan noget, for at diversificere"*
